IsolateCentral.definition: Processing time for isolating at the central system for each intervention

ScanCentral.definition: Processing time for scanning at the central system for each intervention

IsolateDistributed.definition: Processing time for isolating at the distributed system for each intervention

ScanDistributed.definition: Processing time for scanning at the distributed system for each intervention

CentralMaxHours.definition: Maximum hours of operation for the central system

DistributedMaxHours.definition: Maximum hours of operation for the distributed system

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of interventions (central and distributed processing) required to halt the intruder's progress, subject to processing time and capacity constraints."

constraints.description: For each cluster i, the decision variables indicating the selected intervention type and method must be binary (0 or 1)
constraints.formulation: $\\forall i = 1, \\dots, N:\\; IsolateCentralChoice[i],\\; ScanCentralChoice[i],\\; IsolateDistributedChoice[i],\\; ScanDistributedChoice[i] \\in \\{0,1\\}$

constraints.description: For each cluster i, the sum of decision variables over all intervention type and method combinations must equal 1
constraints.formulation: $\\forall i \\in \\{1, \\dots, N\\}: \\; IsolateCentralChoice[i] + ScanCentralChoice[i] + IsolateDistributedChoice[i] + ScanDistributedChoice[i] = 1$

constraints.description: The total central processing time, computed as the sum over all clusters of the selected central intervention processing times (isolate or scan as chosen), must not exceed CentralMaxHours
The total distributed processing time, computed as the sum over all clusters of the selected distributed intervention processing times (isolate or scan as chosen), must not exceed DistributedMaxHours

IsolateCentralChoice.definition: Equals 1 if cluster i is assigned the isolate intervention processed centrally, 0 otherwise

ScanCentralChoice.definition: Equals 1 if cluster i is assigned the scan intervention processed centrally, 0 otherwise

IsolateDistributedChoice.definition: Equals 1 if cluster i is assigned the isolate intervention processed in a distributed manner, 0 otherwise

ScanDistributedChoice.definition: Equals 1 if cluster i is assigned the scan intervention processed in a distributed manner, 0 otherwise
